attributes.description: Golden signals dashboard for Temporal Cloud — latency, traffic, errors, and saturation from the Temporal Cloud OpenMetrics endpoint.

params.markdown:
## [Temporal OTel] Cloud Metrics

Monitor Temporal Cloud golden signals collected from the OpenMetrics endpoint:
- **Latency**: Workflow end-to-end and frontend gRPC operation latency
- **Traffic**: Workflow and activity completion rates, service request rates
- **Errors**: Activity task failures, timeouts, no-poller conditions
- **Saturation**: Task queue backlog, open workflows, rate limit utilization

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Success Rate (/sec)` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Success Rate (/sec)` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count))

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of workflow executions completing successfully per second across all namespaces (filtered by the Namespace control). The primary throughput signal for Temporal workflows.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Activity Success Rate` = ROUND(SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_success_count)), 2)

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Activity Success Rate` = ROUND(SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_success_count)), 2)

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of activity task completions per second. The primary throughput signal for activity execution. A sustained drop while workflow success rate holds suggests a specific activity type or worker pool is struggling.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Peak Open Workflows` = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Peak Open Workflows` = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows))

embeddableConfig.description: Maximum number of in-flight workflow executions across all namespaces during the selected time range. Sustained growth without proportional throughput growth suggests workflows are accumulating — blocked on tasks, stuck in retry loops, or running indefinitely.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Timeout Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Timeout Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count))

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of workflow executions timing out per second — exceeding their workflowExecutionTimeout without completing. A non-zero rate indicates backlogged task queues, overloaded workers, or timeout values set too aggressively.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Failure Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Failure Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count))

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of workflow executions failing per second — exhausting retries or encountering non-retryable errors. Distinct from timeouts: the workflow ran out of retry budget, not wall-clock time.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Activity Task Failure Rate /sec` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Activity Task Failure Rate /sec` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count))

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of individual activity task attempt failures per second. Activity failures may be retried; sustained high rates exhaust retry budgets and lead to workflow failures.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS rate_by_min = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
// Per-second rate averaged over each minute; * 60 estimates the count for the selected time range
| STATS total_no_poller = ROUND(SUM(rate_by_min) * 60, 0)

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS rate_by_min = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
// Per-second rate averaged over each minute; * 60 estimates the count for the selected time range
| STATS total_no_poller = ROUND(SUM(rate_by_min) * 60, 0)

embeddableConfig.description: Estimated rate of tasks dispatched to task queues with zero active pollers (no_poller_tasks_count × 60 s). A non-zero value means workers for at least one task queue are absent — every new task for that queue is immediately stuck.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Service Request Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Service Request Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count))

embeddableConfig.description: Total rate of gRPC frontend service requests per second, across all operation types. The baseline traffic signal for Temporal Cloud service load.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Peak Task Backlog` = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count))

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Peak Task Backlog` = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count))

embeddableConfig.description: Maximum number of pending tasks across all task queues during the selected time range. A growing backlog indicates tasks are arriving faster than workers can process them — the primary capacity saturation signal.

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS p99_s = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_schedule_to_close_latency_p99)) BY workflow_type = attributes.temporal_workflow_type, time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS p99_s = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_schedule_to_close_latency_p99)) BY workflow_type = attributes.temporal_workflow_type, time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: 99th-percentile workflow end-to-end latency (schedule to close), broken down by workflow type, sampled at the Temporal Cloud 1-minute aggregation window. Rising p99 indicates backlogged task queues, overloaded workers, or increasingly complex workflow logic.
embeddableConfig.title: Workflow Schedule-to-Close 1-min p99

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS p99_s = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_latency_p99)) BY operation = attributes.operation, time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| EVAL p99_ms = ROUND(p99_s * 1000, 1)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS p99_s = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_latency_p99)) BY operation = attributes.operation, time_bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
| EVAL p99_ms = ROUND(p99_s * 1000, 1)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

attributes.title: Frontend Service 1-min p99 Latency by Operation

embeddableConfig.description: 99th-percentile gRPC frontend latency per API operation, sampled at the Temporal Cloud 1-minute aggregation window. Latency spikes here propagate directly to all client operations (StartWorkflow, PollActivityTask, etc.).
embeddableConfig.title: Frontend Service 1-min p99 Latency by Operation

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Service Request Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count)) BY operation = attributes.operation, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Service Request Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_count)) BY operation = attributes.operation, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Total gRPC frontend request rate broken down by operation type. Identifies which API methods are responsible for traffic growth or unusual patterns across the service.
embeddableConfig.title: Service Request Rate by Operation

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS success_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS success_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of workflow executions completing successfully per second, stacked by namespace. Stacking shows total throughput and each namespace's contribution to it. Use the Namespace control to isolate individual namespaces when cardinality is high.
embeddableConfig.title: Workflow Successes/sec by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS activity_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_success_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS activity_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_success_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of activity task completions per second, stacked by namespace. Stacking shows total activity throughput and each namespace's contribution. A namespace dropping out of the stack indicates a worker or connectivity issue for that tenant.
embeddableConfig.title: Activity Successes/sec by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `No-Poller Tasks/sec` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count)) BY task_queue = attributes.temporal_task_queue, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `No-Poller Tasks/sec` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count)) BY task_queue = attributes.temporal_task_queue, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of tasks dispatched to task queues that have zero active pollers, broken down by task queue. A non-zero value means work is arriving for a queue with no worker listening — every new task for that queue is immediately stuck. The most critical worker-health signal.
embeddableConfig.title: No-Poller Tasks/sec by Task Queue

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Timeout Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, `time_bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `time_bucket` ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Timeout Rate` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, `time_bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT `time_bucket` ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of workflow executions timing out (exceeding their workflowExecutionTimeout), stacked by namespace. Workflow timeouts are distinct from failures: the workflow ran out of wall-clock time, not retry budget. Sustained timeouts indicate blocked workers or backlogged task queues.
embeddableConfig.title: Workflow Timeout Rate by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Failures/sec` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, `time_bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Workflow Failures/sec` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, `time_bucket` = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of workflow executions failing (exhausting retries or encountering non-retryable errors), stacked by namespace. Stacking shows total failure rate and which namespace is the primary source of failures.
embeddableConfig.title: Workflow Failures/sec by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.temporal_namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS wt = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)), af = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count)), np = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count)), at = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_timeout_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
// Per-second rate averaged over each minute; * 60 estimates the count for the selected time range
| STATS workflow_timeouts = ROUND(SUM(wt) * 60, 0), activity_task_failures = ROUND(SUM(af) * 60, 0), no_poller_tasks = ROUND(SUM(np) * 60, 0), activity_task_timeouts = ROUND(SUM(at) * 60, 0) BY namespace
| SORT workflow_timeouts DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 50

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.temporal_namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS wt = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)), af = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count)), np = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_no_poller_tasks_count)), at = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_timeout_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
// Per-second rate averaged over each minute; * 60 estimates the count for the selected time range
| STATS workflow_timeouts = ROUND(SUM(wt) * 60, 0), activity_task_failures = ROUND(SUM(af) * 60, 0), no_poller_tasks = ROUND(SUM(np) * 60, 0), activity_task_timeouts = ROUND(SUM(at) * 60, 0) BY namespace
| SORT workflow_timeouts DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 50

embeddableConfig.description: Estimated total error counts per namespace for the selected time range. Counts are derived by multiplying per-second rates by 60 × number of minutes in the range. Sorted by estimated workflow timeouts descending — the highest-impact error type.
embeddableConfig.title: Estimated Error Counts by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS wt = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)), wf = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count)), af = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count)), at = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_timeout_count)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
// Per-second rate averaged over each minute; * 60 estimates the count for the selected time range
| STATS `Est. Workflow Timeouts` = ROUND(SUM(wt) * 60, 0), `Est. Workflow Failures` = ROUND(SUM(wf) * 60, 0), `Est. Activity Task Failures` = ROUND(SUM(af) * 60, 0), `Est. Activity Task Timeouts` = ROUND(SUM(at) * 60, 0)

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS wt = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)), wf = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count)), af = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count)), at = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_timeout_count)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(1 minute)
// Per-second rate averaged over each minute; * 60 estimates the count for the selected time range
| STATS `Est. Workflow Timeouts` = ROUND(SUM(wt) * 60, 0), `Est. Workflow Failures` = ROUND(SUM(wf) * 60, 0), `Est. Activity Task Failures` = ROUND(SUM(af) * 60, 0), `Est. Activity Task Timeouts` = ROUND(SUM(at) * 60, 0)

embeddableConfig.description: Estimated error count distribution across four error categories for the selected time range: workflow timeouts, workflow failures, activity task failures, and activity task timeouts. Counts are estimated as per-second rates × 60 × duration in minutes.
embeddableConfig.title: Error Type Breakdown

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS fail_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS fail_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_fail_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of individual activity task attempt failures, stacked by namespace. Activity failures may be retried; sustained high rates exhaust retry budgets and lead to workflow failures. Stacking shows which namespace is the dominant failure source.
embeddableConfig.title: Activity Task Failures/sec by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS timeout_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_timeout_count)) BY timeout_type = attributes.timeout_type, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS timeout_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_activity_task_timeout_count)) BY timeout_type = attributes.timeout_type, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

attributes.title: Activity Task Timeouts/sec by Timeout Type

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of activity task timeouts broken down by timeout type (StartToClose, Heartbeat). StartToClose timeouts indicate workers are exceeding their per-attempt time limit. Heartbeat timeouts indicate workers stopped reporting progress mid-execution — the worker process likely crashed or hung. Both types may be retried but persistent rates signal systemic problems.
embeddableConfig.title: Activity Task Timeouts/sec by Timeout Type

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS throttled = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_throttled_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS throttled = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_request_throttled_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of throttled gRPC frontend requests, stacked by namespace. Throttling occurs when a namespace exceeds its rate limits. Sustained throttling causes task queue backlogs and workflow latency.
embeddableConfig.title: Throttled Requests/sec by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS exhausted = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_resource_exhausted_error_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS exhausted = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_resource_exhausted_error_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Rate of resource-exhausted gRPC errors, stacked by namespace. These occur when Temporal Cloud throttles requests due to rate limit or quota exhaustion — the leading indicator before action-rate-limit alerts fire.
embeddableConfig.title: Resource Exhausted Errors/sec by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Task Queue Backlog` = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count)) BY task_queue = attributes.temporal_task_queue, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS `Task Queue Backlog` = MAX(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count)) BY task_queue = attributes.temporal_task_queue, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Approximate number of pending tasks broken down by task queue over time. A growing backlog indicates tasks are arriving faster than workers can process them. The primary capacity saturation signal for individual worker pools.
embeddableConfig.title: Task Queue Backlog

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.temporal_namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS open_workflows = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows)), avg_action_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_count)) WHERE attributes.is_background == "false", avg_action_limit = AVG(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_action_limit), max_backlog = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count)), ops_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_count)), ops_limit = MAX(max_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_limit)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace
| EVAL ops_util_pct = ROUND(CASE(ops_limit > 0, 100 * ops_rate / ops_limit, null), 3)
| SORT ops_util_pct DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 50

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.temporal_namespace IS NOT NULL
| STATS open_workflows = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows)), avg_action_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_count)) WHERE attributes.is_background == "false", avg_action_limit = AVG(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_action_limit), max_backlog = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_approximate_backlog_count)), ops_rate = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_count)), ops_limit = MAX(max_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_limit)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace
| EVAL ops_util_pct = ROUND(CASE(ops_limit > 0, 100 * ops_rate / ops_limit, null), 3)
| SORT ops_util_pct DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 50

embeddableConfig.description: Snapshot of saturation metrics per namespace: open workflows, average action rate vs provisioned limit, peak task backlog, and operations quota utilization. Sorted by operations utilization descending — the quota signal that triggers throttling at 80%. The shipped alert rule fires at 80% utilization.
embeddableConfig.title: Capacity Summary by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS open_workflows = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS open_workflows = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_namespace_open_workflows)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Number of in-flight workflow executions per namespace over time. Sustained growth without proportional throughput growth suggests workflows are not completing — blocked on tasks, stuck in retry loops, or running indefinitely.
embeddableConfig.title: Open Workflows by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS action_rate = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_count)) WHERE attributes.is_background == "false", action_limit = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_action_limit)), ops_rate = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_count)), ops_limit = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_limit)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Action Utilization %` = CASE(action_limit > 0, 100 * action_rate / action_limit, null), `Operations Utilization %` = CASE(ops_limit > 0, 100 * ops_rate / ops_limit, null)
| KEEP time_bucket, namespace, `Action Utilization %`, `Operations Utilization %`
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS action_rate = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_total_action_count)) WHERE attributes.is_background == "false", action_limit = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_action_limit)), ops_rate = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_count)), ops_limit = MAX(MAX_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_operations_limit)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL `Action Utilization %` = CASE(action_limit > 0, 100 * action_rate / action_limit, null), `Operations Utilization %` = CASE(ops_limit > 0, 100 * ops_rate / ops_limit, null)
| KEEP time_bucket, namespace, `Action Utilization %`, `Operations Utilization %`
| SORT time_bucket ASC

attributes.title: Action & Operations Quota Utilization by Namespace

embeddableConfig.description: Action and operations quota utilization percentage per namespace over time. At 80% utilization there is insufficient headroom to absorb traffic spikes — the shipped alert rule fires at this threshold. Separately tracks action-rate and operations-rate utilization because they have independent limits.
embeddableConfig.title: Action & Operations Quota Utilization by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS pending = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_pending_requests)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS pending = MAX(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_service_pending_requests)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| SORT time_bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: Number of gRPC frontend requests waiting to be processed (in-flight but not yet responded to) per namespace. A leading indicator of service saturation — rising pending requests precede latency increases.
embeddableConfig.title: Service Pending Requests by Namespace

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS billable = SUM(avg_over_time(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_billable_action_count)) BY namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace, time_bucket = TBUCKET(50, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

query.esql:
TS metrics-temporal.cloud_metrics.otel-*
| STATS Succeeded = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_success_count)), Failed = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_failed_count)), `Timed Out` = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_timeout_count)), Terminated = SUM(AVG_OVER_TIME(metrics.temporal_cloud_v1_workflow_terminate_count)) BY `Workflow Type` = attributes.temporal_workflow_type, Namespace = attributes.temporal_namespace
| EVAL s = CASE(Succeeded IS NOT NULL, Succeeded, 0.0), f = CASE(Failed IS NOT NULL, Failed, 0.0), t = CASE(`Timed Out` IS NOT NULL, `Timed Out`, 0.0), x = CASE(Terminated IS NOT NULL, Terminated, 0.0)
| WHERE s + f + t + x > 0
| EVAL total = s + f + t + x
| EVAL `Success %` = ROUND(100 * s / total, 2), `Failure %` = ROUND(100 * f / total, 2), `Timed Out %` = ROUND(100 * t / total, 2)
| EVAL `Terminated %` = ROUND(100 - `Success %` - `Failure %` - `Timed Out %`, 2)
| KEEP Namespace, `Workflow Type`, `Success %`, `Failure %`, `Timed Out %`, `Terminated %`
| SORT `Success %` ASC, `Failure %` DESC
| LIMIT 50

query.esql:
